description: Generates an isolated self-signed test code-signing certificate in the Current-User store, signs reversible disposable copies of the FastFiles product binaries with signtool using the certificate store, and verifies the Authenticode signature plus the pinned-thumbprint behavior the product enforces. The binary bytes and test certificate are restored or removed before return; no PFX/password or Current-User Root trust is persisted. A production OV/EV certificate is an injectable secret; when absent the production gate reports SKIPPED(production-cert-not-provided) and never disables verification.
